name: Core Photo Retrieval Experience Discovery 2024
description: Exploratory research into episodic and contextual memory failure modes when retrieving photos in Google Photos without exact metadata.
research_questions: What types of memory cues do users recall when searching for photos?
Why does visual and textual search fail for complex scenes?
What is the abandonment rate for queries lacking exact dates or locations?

name: Multi-Modal Conversational Photo Search Benchmark
description: Benchmarking natural language and conversational search queries against traditional metadata filtering in Google Photos.
research_questions: How do users express temporal uncertainty in natural language search?
Can conversational follow-up questions resolve vague visual recollections?
